tess_rule: TESS sectors 1-110: the last sector begun by 2026-10-18, counting 27.4-day sectors from 25 Jul 2018 (good to about one sector); planned sectors are not counted.
method: Fractions: the share of equal-area sky cells (Fibonacci sphere) whose centre lies in the footprint: 12,288 cells (about 3.4 square degrees each) for TESS and the unmapped sky, 196,608 cells (about 0.21 square degrees each) for Kepler, K2, CoRoT and the bulge.

kepler.label: K2fov footprint model; Kepler field centre RA 290.6667°, Dec +44.5°

corot.label: CoRoT observing zones, 10° radius at RA 6h50m and 18h50m

bulge.label: approximate bulge region observed by OGLE and KMTNet

gaia: Gaia observes the whole sky; astrometry is not a footprint here.
